question: Does a real ONNX Runtime Web session initialise and RUN in PratiBimb's extension contexts, on each backend?
scope: ONE 174-byte two-op synthetic model. Establishes RUNTIME VIABILITY only. Does NOT satisfy QG-03, which needs the twenty model cells.

runtime.wasm_artifacts: ort-wasm-simd-threaded.wasm (13.9 MB) and ort-wasm-simd-threaded.jsep.wasm (27.8 MB) - NOT COMMITTED. harness/build-extension.js pulls them from the pinned package. CI blocks files over 5 MB and SECURITY.md requires large binaries be referenced by pinned revision.

model.graph: Mul by 2 then Add 1, over float32[1, 262144]; opset 13, ir_version 9

model.embedded: base64 inside the probe, so no fetch is performed for the model
model.provenance: generated synthetic. NOT a production model. No Qwen. Nothing downloaded.
